entries.summary: Quality pass on the free CSA practice questions and the Brazil delta questions. An automated scoring script ranked every free question (answer-position spread, whether the longest option was the answer, duplicate stems, explanation depth, scenario stems, documentation links); the worst-scoring questions in each topic were rewritten with AI assistance against current ServiceNow product documentation, then re-checked one by one against the cited documentation page in a separate pass. These questions have not been individually reviewed by a person.
changes: Removed 7 questions that repeated another question's stem word for word or nearly so (UI navigation 1, user administration 1, self-service 2, reporting 3).

Corrected 6 answers that did not match current documentation: how Allow-If access controls combine, what High Security Settings adds, the Scheduled change state, who can read a knowledge base with no read criteria, when resolving a problem resolves its linked incidents, and the current name of Analytics Center (now Analytics Overview).

Rewrote 74 more questions so that answer options are similar in length and the longest option is no longer a giveaway, turned definition questions into short scenarios where it read naturally, and explained why each wrong option is wrong.
Replaced training-course links with links to the specific ServiceNow documentation page (Brazil release) in every rewritten question.
Updated reporting questions for Platform Analytics (data visualizations, inline and technical dashboards) and fixed delta questions that named the wrong release.
Left 7 questions unchanged because their key fact could not be confirmed in current documentation; they are queued for rewrite or removal.

entries.summary: Quality pass on the free CAD practice questions and the Brazil delta questions, using the same process: automated scoring, AI-assisted rewrites against current ServiceNow documentation, and a separate check of each rewritten question against the cited documentation page. These questions have not been individually reviewed by a person.
changes: Removed 1 question that duplicated another (where client scripts run).
Replaced documentation links that no longer resolved in 10 free questions with working links to current documentation pages.
Rewrote 13 free questions and 7 Brazil delta questions with parallel, similar-length options, scenario stems and an explanation for every wrong option.
Reworked the REST question to match how the Table API documents GET, POST, PATCH and DELETE.
Left 2 questions' wording unchanged (script include scope and UI policy run order) because the claim could not be confirmed in current documentation; only their broken links were replaced.
